moments.title: Carabao Cup First Round Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The first competitive matches of the 2026/27 English football season begin this weekend with the Carabao Cup First Round fixtures taking place across the UK.

angles.name: Cup Football Begins
angles.copy: It's the real start of the 2026/27 football season! The Carabao Cup First Round is on this weekend, bringing knockout action to grounds across the country. Who are you backing for an early cup run?

angles.name: Local Teams in Action
angles.copy: Your local teams are back in competitive action! The Carabao Cup First Round is happening today and tomorrow. Find out if your club is playing and get ready for some cup magic.

moments.title: The Hundred Finals Day Approaching
moments.blurb: The Hundred 2026 season culminates next Sunday with Finals Day at Lord's, featuring both the men's and women's finals after a month of 100-ball cricket action.

angles.name: Cricket Showdown
angles.copy: It's Finals Week for The Hundred! All roads lead to Lord's next Sunday for the men's and women's finals. Who do you think will lift the trophy this year?

angles.name: Lord's Hosts Finals
angles.copy: The Home of Cricket, Lord's, is gearing up for The Hundred Finals Day next Sunday, August 16th. Get ready for a day of explosive 100-ball action!

moments.title: Community Shield in Cardiff
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Premier League champions Arsenal and FA Cup winners Manchester City, will be played at Principality Stadium in Cardiff next Sunday, August 16th.

angles.name: Season Curtain Raiser
angles.copy: The Community Shield is next Sunday! Arsenal take on Manchester City in Cardiff, kicking off the new top-flight football season. Who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Cardiff Hosts Shield
angles.copy: Principality Stadium in Cardiff is set to host the Community Shield next Sunday, August 16th. A huge occasion for Welsh football fans to see two of England's biggest clubs!

moments.title: EFL Championship Season Starts
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 EFL Championship season kicks off next weekend, with the first match, Wolves vs Blackburn, scheduled for Friday, August 14th.

angles.name: Championship Returns
angles.copy: Get ready, Championship fans! The new season officially starts next Friday, August 14th, with Wolves taking on Blackburn. Who's your pick for promotion this year?

angles.name: Football League Back
angles.copy: Beyond the Premier League, the EFL Championship is back next weekend! Expect drama, passion, and incredible goals from Friday onwards. What game are you most looking forward to?

moments.title: Happy 72nd to Joe Jackson
moments.blurb: English singer-songwriter and musician Joe Jackson, known for hits like 'Is She Really Going Out with Him?' and 'Steppin' Out', turns 72 on August 11th.

angles.name: Celebrating Joe Jackson
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 72nd birthday to the iconic Joe Jackson on August 11th! From new wave anthems to jazz-infused pop, his career has been incredible. What's your favourite Joe Jackson track?

angles.name: Joe Jackson 72
angles.copy: Still Steppin' Out at 72! Happy Birthday to the brilliant Joe Jackson, celebrating on August 11th. A true musical chameleon.

moments.title: Ben Gibbard Turns 50
moments.blurb: Ben Gibbard, lead vocalist and guitarist for Death Cab for Cutie and one half of The Postal Service, celebrates his 50th birthday on August 11th.

angles.name: Happy Half-Century Ben
angles.copy: Happy 50th Birthday to the incredible Ben Gibbard! A voice of a generation with Death Cab for Cutie and The Postal Service. What's your go-to track?

angles.name: Celebrating Gibbard
angles.copy: From 'Transatlanticism' to 'Give Up', Ben Gibbard's songwriting has defined eras. Wishing him a very happy 50th on August 11th!

moments.title: Charlie Sexton's 58th Birthday
moments.blurb: Guitarist, singer-songwriter, and long-time member of Bob Dylan's touring band, Charlie Sexton, celebrates his 58th birthday on August 11th.

angles.name: Rocking On at 58
angles.copy: Happy 58th Birthday to the legendary Charlie Sexton on August 11th! A phenomenal guitarist who's played with the best, including Bob Dylan.

angles.name: Birthday Shoutout Sexton
angles.copy: Wishing a rockin' 58th to Charlie Sexton! His guitar work has graced so many stages and albums. Celebrate his birthday on August 11th with some great tunes.

moments.title: Sarah Brightman Turns 66
moments.blurb: Renowned classical crossover soprano and actress Sarah Brightman, known for her powerful voice and theatrical performances, celebrates her 66th birthday on August 14th.

angles.name: Diva's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to the magnificent Sarah Brightman on August 14th! Her voice has soared across stages worldwide. What's your favourite of her iconic performances?

angles.name: Celebrating Sarah
angles.copy: Wishing a spectacular 66th birthday to the one and only Sarah Brightman! A true star of classical crossover.

moments.title: Larry Graham's 80th Birthday
moments.blurb: Legendary bassist Larry Graham, best known for his work with Sly and the Family Stone and as a solo artist, celebrates his 80th birthday on August 14th.

angles.name: Funk Pioneer at 80
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the incredible Larry Graham on August 14th! A true pioneer of funk bass with Sly and the Family Stone. Get those grooves on!

angles.name: Bass Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 80th to the legendary Larry Graham! His thumping bass lines changed music forever. Celebrate his big day on August 14th.

moments.title: Joe Jonas Turns 37
moments.blurb: Singer and actor Joe Jonas, known for his work with the Jonas Brothers and DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday on August 15th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Joe Jonas
angles.copy: Can you believe Joe Jonas is 37 on August 15th?! From boyband heartthrob to pop-rock sensation, he's still got it. What's your favourite Jonas Brothers or DNCE track?

angles.name: Celebrating Joe
angles.copy: Wishing a big 37th birthday to Joe Jonas on August 15th! Always bringing the energy.

moments.title: Mikey Graham Turns 54
moments.blurb: Irish singer Mikey Graham, best known as a member of the hugely popular boyband Boyzone, celebrates his 54th birthday on August 15th.

angles.name: Boyzone Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to Boyzone's very own Mikey Graham on August 15th! Still looking good, still sounding great. What's your top Boyzone ballad?

angles.name: Celebrating Mikey
angles.copy: Wishing a fantastic 54th to Mikey Graham! Boyzone fans, let's hear it for the birthday boy on August 15th.

moments.title: Jimmy Webb Turns 80
moments.blurb: Acclaimed American songwriter, composer, and singer Jimmy Webb, known for writing numerous hit songs like 'Wichita Lineman' and 'MacArthur Park', celebrates his 80th birthday on August 15th.

angles.name: Songwriting Legend at 80
angles.copy: Happy 80th Birthday to the songwriting genius Jimmy Webb on August 15th! Responsible for some of the most beautiful and enduring songs of all time.

angles.name: Celebrating Webb
angles.copy: From Glen Campbell to Richard Harris, Jimmy Webb's songs have touched millions. Wishing him a very happy 80th birthday on August 15th!

moments.title: Tommy Aldridge Turns 76
moments.blurb: Veteran rock drummer Tommy Aldridge, known for his work with Whitesnake, Ozzy Osbourne, Thin Lizzy, and Gary Moore, celebrates his 76th birthday on August 15th.

angles.name: Rock Drummer's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the powerhouse drummer Tommy Aldridge on August 15th! A true legend of rock, having laid down beats for Whitesnake, Ozzy and more.

angles.name: Aldridge at 76
angles.copy: Still drumming up a storm! Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the iconic Tommy Aldridge on August 15th.

moments.title: Matt Johnson Turns 63
moments.blurb: Matt Johnson, the lead vocalist and primary songwriter of the influential English post-punk band The The, celebrates his 63rd birthday on August 15th.

angles.name: The The's Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 63rd Birthday to the brilliant Matt Johnson of The The on August 15th! A unique voice in British music. What's your favourite The The album?

angles.name: Celebrating Matt Johnson
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 63rd birthday to Matt Johnson! The creative force behind The The, celebrating on August 15th.

moments.title: UK Summer Holidays Continue
moments.blurb: The summer school holidays are in full swing across the UK, with many families enjoying breaks before schools in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland return in early September. Scotland's schools typically return around mid-August.

angles.name: Summer Fun Continues
angles.copy: It's still summer holiday season for many across the UK! Whether you're staycationing or heading abroad, make the most of these sunny days.

angles.name: Making Memories
angles.copy: School's out for summer! For those still on holiday, what adventures are you having? Share your favourite summer memories with us!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds / Creamfields Festival Buzz
moments.blurb: Excitement is building for the UK's major bank holiday festivals, Reading & Leeds and Creamfields, both taking place from August 27-30, with full line-ups already announced.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Not long until Reading & Leeds and Creamfields! If you're heading to a festival this August Bank Holiday, who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Festival Lineups Locked
angles.copy: With Reading & Leeds and Creamfields just weeks away, the full lineups are looking massive. Get ready for some epic sets!
